title: Captain Whiskers and the Great Yarn Adventure
author: Hamidreza Rostami
short_description: A brave cat sails on a yarn boat to rescue a tangled ball of yarn.
long_description: Captain Whiskers isn't an ordinary cat—he's a sailor who commands the S.S. Purr-fect, a boat made entirely of yarn. When he discovers that Grandma's special yarn ball is unraveling and leading somewhere mysterious, he sets off on an adventure. Following the yarn thread through the living room, under the couch, and up the chair leg, he reaches Grandma's knitting basket. But there, he finds a tangled ball of yarn in distress. With patience and care, Captain Whiskers untangles the yarn and helps it return to its rightful place. A charming story about adventure, patience, and helping others.

main_characters.name: Captain Whiskers
main_characters.description: An orange tabby cat with a blue captain's hat, a red bandana, and a brave expression. He has a fluffy tail and bright green eyes.

main_characters.name: Grandma
main_characters.description: An elderly woman with silver hair, round glasses, and a cozy sweater. She's always knitting.

main_characters.name: Tangled Yarn
main_characters.description: A ball of yarn that has become tangled and distressed. It has a sad, knotted appearance.
